scoring_justification: Checker recomputes exchange parameters from formulas and inputs using high-precision arithmetic and compares each field with absolute tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold ambient J values and pressure derivatives computed from the paper's formulas with CODATA2018 constants
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Recomputed from the paper's Eqs. 6-10 using the published inputs and CODATA2018 values for Bohr magneton and Boltzmann constant; consistent with solution/solve.sh output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the deterministic output of the given algebraic formulas with the specified constants; they are not arbitrary numbers.

outputs.description: Ambient-pressure exchange parameters J0/kB, J1/kB, J2/kB, J3/kB in Kelvin, computed from the given critical fields and Néel temperature using the mean-field ANNNI model.
Logarithmic pressure derivatives of J0, J1, J2, J3 in %/GPa, computed by differentiating the exchange formulas with respect to pressure.

output_contract.notes: All inputs are provided in the instructions. Physical constants should use standard CODATA2018 values. The computation is deterministic and simple; results can be recomputed independently.
